2609.18844.title: ReFigBench: Benchmarking Scientific Figure Reconstruction as Editable PowerPoint Artifacts
2609.18844.paper_summary: Multimodal coding agents are expected to turn visual inputs into usable artifacts, and they act through a harness, the layer of tools, context management, and execution environment around the model. Existing evaluations often isolate short tool calls, API traces, or screenshot resemblance, and a low score under these proxies cannot say whether the model saw poorly, planned poorly, or was failed by its harness. We study scientific overview figure reconstruction, an agent task in which a source image must become an editable PowerPoint slide that preserves text, topology, layout, and native document structure. We introduce ReFigBench, a benchmark and evaluation framework built on 1,000 real overview figures retrieved from arXiv papers with full provenance. Coding agents from four model families reconstruct every figure under two workflows, direct code generation and a specialized PPTX workflow, and the strongest model runs inside two commercial harnesses, yielding ten configurations. Evaluation combines deterministic artifact checks, repeated automated scoring by judges from two model families, and blinded human comparisons. Perception remains a bottleneck that iterative rendering only partly repays. Whether workflow effort converts into quality depends on the model together with its harness, since the same model gains from the specialized workflow inside one harness and loses inside the other, and the harness shifts scores even under an identical direct prompt. The specialized workflow erases native connectors in every configuration, human judges still prefer its renderings in most matchups, and even the strongest agent falls short of the rubric ceiling. These results expose the tension between fidelity and editability as the central challenge for practical multimodal document agents.
2609.18844.paper_summary_zh: 多模態編碼代理預期能將視覺輸入轉化為可用的工件，它們透過一個束帶運作，這是圍繞模型的工具層、上下文管理和執行環境。現有的評估通常孤立短期工具調用、API 跟蹤或截圖相似性，而在這些代理下的低分無法說明模型是視覺效果差、計劃不佳，還是被其束帶所限制。我們研究科學概述圖的重建，這是一個代理任務，其中源圖像必須變成一個可編輯的 PowerPoint 幻燈片，並保留文本、拓撲、佈局和原生文檔結構。我們介紹 ReFigBench，一個基於從 arXiv 論文中檢索的 1,000 個真實概述圖的基準和評估框架，並附有完整的來源。來自四個模型家族的編碼代理在兩個工作流程下重建每個圖形，直接代碼生成和專門的 PPTX 工作流程，而最強的模型在兩個商業束帶內運行，產生十種配置。評估結合了確定性工件檢查、來自兩個模型家族的評審的重複自動打分，以及盲人比較。感知仍然是一個瓶頸，迭代渲染僅部分解決了這個問題。工作流程的努力是否轉化為質量取決於模型及其束帶，因為同一模型在一個束帶內從專門工作流程中獲益，而在另一個束帶內則失去收益，即使在相同的直接提示下，束帶也會改變分數。專門的工作流程在每個配置中都抹去了原生連接器，但人類評審在大多數對決中仍然偏好其渲染，甚至最強的代理也未達到標準上限。這些結果揭示了忠實度和可編輯性之間的緊張關係，這是實用多模態文檔代理的核心挑戰。
